parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: GrayRule
parameters.description: The canary release rule. For a beta release, you can specify one or more client IP addresses for this parameter. You must separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,). For a tag-based canary release, the value is in the format of Tag name=Tag value. You must separate multiple tag values with commas (,).

parameters.name: GrayType
parameters.description: The canary release type. Beta release (IP address-based canary release) and tag-based canary release are supported.

parameters.name: Group
parameters.description: The group name. Default value: DEFAULT\_GROUP.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The namespace ID. Default value: public.

parameters.name: OpType
parameters.description: The operation type. Valid values: Create (create a canary release configuration) and Update (update an existing canary release configuration).

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: The extended request parameter in the JSON format.

parameters.name: StopGray
parameters.description: Specifies whether to stop the canary release.
